human_feedback.interpretation: The current title reads as generic brush lettering rather than a custom brand wordmark, and the poster test reads as a photo with overlaid text rather than an integrated poster composition.

diagnosis: The title and support copy are stacked in one upper text column over an unchanged photograph.
The layout has hierarchy by size but lacks a stronger compositional system, photo-title interaction, secondary spatial axis, or designed negative-space structure.
The vector cleanup improved production cleanliness but did not add brand-specific structural identity; the result remains brush-calligraphic.
